items.title: 20.4 Electrophilic substitution reactions mein orientation (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of orientation in electrophilic substitution (PDF 68-69).

blocks.text: Benzene ring par pehle se maujood group electrophilic substitution par asar karta aur tay karta hai ke aane wala electrophile kahan jaye (orientation). Substituents electrophile ko do tareeqon se raasta dikhate hain.

Ortho-para director ring ko benzene se zyada reactive banata aur electrophile ko ortho (1,2) aur para (1,4) positions par bhejta hai, para ki taraf thore rujhan ke saath; meta product bohat mamooli zimni product hai. Misalein -SR, -R, -OH, -OR, -NR2 aur -SH hain: aise groups jo ring ko electrons de sakte hain.

Methylbenzene ke ring mein chlorination aluminium chloride (bromine ke liye aluminium bromide) ya lohe ke saath, kamre ke darja hararat par aur UV roshni ki ghair maujoodgi mein hoti hai. Methyl group 2,4-directing hai, is liye product 2-chloromethylbenzene aur 4-chloromethylbenzene ka mixture hai: C6H5CH3 + Cl2 -> CH3C6H4Cl + HCl. Bromine milte julte bromo compounds deta hai. CH3 ki tarah phenol ka OH group bhi ring ko fa'aal karta hai, aur aane wale groups positions 2, 4 aur 6 par jate hain.

Meta director ring ko benzene se kam reactive banata aur electrophile ko meta (1,3) position par bhejta hai. Yeh groups zyada tar electrons kheenchte aur arenium darmiyani halat ko na-mustahkam karte hain. Misalein -CN, C=O groups (-CHO, -COR), -NO2 aur -COOH hain. Nitrobenzene ki chlorination meta position par hoti, 3-chloronitrobenzene banta hai.

blocks.alt: Oopar: methylbenzene + Cl2, AlCl3 ke saath aur UV ke baghair, 2-chloromethylbenzene + 4-chloromethylbenzene + HCl deta; note: CH3 ring mein electrons dhakelta hai is liye positions 2 aur 4 react karti hain. Neeche: nitrobenzene + Cl2, AlCl3 ke saath, 3-chloronitrobenzene + HCl deta; NO2 ring se electrons kheenchta aur naya group position 3 par jata.
blocks.caption: Ortho-para aur meta directing groups (kitab ki misalon ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: CH3 jaisa electron dene wala group ring ko zyada reactive banata aur naye group ko positions 2 aur 4 par bhejta hai. NO2 jaisa electron kheenchne wala group ring ko kam reactive banata aur naye group ko position 3 par bhejta hai.

blocks.title: Halogens khaas soorat hain
blocks.text: Halogen substituents (-Cl, -Br) ring ko benzene se thora kam reactive banate hain, phir bhi naye groups ko ortho aur para positions par bhejte hain. Yeh Quick Checks 20.7 aur 20.8 ke liye zaroori hai.

blocks.prompt: Phenol ki nitration benzene se narm halaat mein kyun ho sakti hai?
blocks.explanation: OH group ring mein electron density (oxygen ka lone pair) deta aur use fa'aal karta hai, is liye kamre ke darja hararat par halka nitric acid kaafi hai.

Pehle benzene ki nitration (conc. HNO3 aur conc. H2SO4, taqreeban 50 C se neeche) se nitrobenzene; phir Cl2 aur AlCl3 (ya FeCl3) se chlorination. NO2 group chlorine ko meta position par bhejta hai. Pehle chlorination karne se nitro group 2 ya 4 par jata.

blocks.prompt: Benzaldehyde, chlorobenzene, phenol aur benzoic acid ki nitration ke ahem products batayein.
blocks.explanation: Benzaldehyde: 3-nitrobenzaldehyde (CHO meta director). Chlorobenzene: 2- aur 4-chloronitrobenzene, zyada tar 4. Phenol: 2- aur 4-nitrophenol (garhe tezaab se 2,4,6-trinitrophenol). Benzoic acid: 3-nitrobenzoic acid. Har aik ke saath doosra product paani hai.
